purpose: Paired retrospective load/line/normal comparison of actual submitted package and unchanged M02 V3.1
observations: All 112 archived V2 observation NPZs, no truth read by preparation or inference

inference.submission: Unmodified extracted ZIP, ml_windowed route, 30 s default and partial final window, full catalog, no retraining
inference.m02: Unmodified JointTensor and public model, exact same archived six-field PMU reports; fresh causal replay

export: Invoke frozen F01 export(): balanced phases A/B/C, wrapped angles, volts/amps/Hz/Hz/s; retain four-frame f/ROCOF NaN warmup and DATA_PRESENT=1

metrics.primary: Shared 30 s windows, classification at window end; label is the physical family if an event occurred anywhere in the window, otherwise E0
metrics.secondary: One decision per complete record; earliest nonzero submitted window, M02 final cause if an alarm occurred
metrics.m02_window_adapter: E0 unless an alarm occurred in this window; otherwise family with maximum sum of M_cause at last available report and top3 cells within that family
metrics.detection: Any nonzero event code is abnormal, including unsupported-family outputs; accuracy/precision/recall/F1, normal false windows and records
metrics.classification: Accuracy, support-weighted F1 over E0-E8, macro-F1 on true common classes E0/E2/E4; out-of-scope predictions remain errors
metrics.localization: Top1 and Top3 exact physical source on every event, and joint correct family+source; unordered line endpoints, typed BUS/LINE
metrics.temporal: M02 first alarm and first frozen diagnosis alarm+0.5s; submitted emission is end of window, never the timestamp to which its retrospective label is broadcast
metrics.unit: Record/windows, not 8 identical PMU rows as independent trials; physical parent is dependence cluster
metrics.failures: Keep all inference failures in denominators; never silently drop

restrictions: No new physical simulations or state resets within records
Not an independent test: M02 development/validation now regression sets; different training/model information across methods
uncertainty: No calibrated-posterior claim; no full E0-E8 or 39-bus coverage claim; not an organizer score
